Take-up Units

UCTN Series

A take-up unit for UC bearing inserts, with a structure in which the shaft centerline is offset to one side. Used for wall mounting, confined spaces, or when the shaft center position needs to be shifted; the adjustment bolt only rotates without shifting position.
